I wouldn’t make “To read” and “Reference” permanent, mutually exclusive types. I’d treat “To read” as a status: I can mark any bookmark for later, then use a quick “Mark as read” action when I’m finished. It should disappear from the To read view but remain in my main collection.

New bookmarks should default to the ordinary/reference state, with the option to mark them To read while saving. The segmented All / To read view works well; a separate Reference view is fine if it means bookmarks not currently marked To read.

I do also want Archive, but as a separate state rather than a third type. Archiving should hide a bookmark from the normal list and normal searches while keeping it available in its own Archived view, and I should be able to restore it. That should remain different from permanently deleting it.
